status: Unrigged likeness study for user review; not approved for the hero
tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS, Cycles; local CPU rendering

provenance.baseTopology: CC0 MakeHuman/MPFB mesh and shirt, taken from the previous local prototype and stripped of all bones, weights, and morph targets.
provenance.face: Portrait-space proportional fit, eye-opening and asymmetry adjustments, tapered lower jaw, and narrower neck; reference-derived baked face texture retained from the initial study. This is not a fully hand-sculpted or fully de-lit production head.
provenance.eyes: Separate 3D eyeballs, brown iris and pupil surfaces, fibers and catchlights.
provenance.hair: New authored wave paths, flattened volumetric locks, joined scalp sculpt, and editable fine surface curves. No generated mesh service was used.
provenance.shirt: CC0-derived draped shirt with separate authored collar leaves and procedural cloth detail.

rebuild.requirements: Blender, the two versioned input assets, and this repository. No API key, account, network call, or MPFB installation is required to run this study script.

reviewLimits: No numerical likeness score is asserted. Compare with the approved artwork visually.
Hair detail, facial proportions and expression still require approval before rigging.
Side and back geometry are interpretations; only one approved view is available.
The current face texture contains reference lighting and needs a dedicated material pass before a production talking avatar.
This high-detail study is not optimized for browser delivery. No GLB was exported and the live hero remains unchanged.
nextGate: User review of neutral likeness before any rig is added to this study.
